Title: vector DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_OR_NULL_AGG (
Description:
DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_OR_NULL_AGG returns a vector of passed values.
    Similar to DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG() but returns NULL
instead of an empty vector if no arguments were passed or only NULLs were passed.
DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_OR_NULL_AGG
DB.DBA.VECTOR_OF_NONNULLS_AGG()
